task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: The robot CAR needs to place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE. However, FRONT_CRATE is an obstacle in front of the robot blocking the path. The plan is: 1) Navigate to FRONT_CRATE, 2) Pick up FRONT_CRATE, 3) Navigate to TEMP_ZONE and place FRONT_CRATE there, 4) Navigate to MEDICINE_BOTTLE, 5) Pick up MEDICINE_BOTTLE, 6) Navigate to MEDICAL_TABLE, 7) Place MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE.
assumptions: FRONT_CRATE is the obstacle in front of the CAR that needs to be removed
TEMP_ZONE is a suitable temporary location to place the FRONT_CRATE
FRONT_CRATE is graspable by the robot
The robot can navigate freely after removing the obstacle
